facts.text: I have noticed a lot of squirrels in my backyard lately.
I live in a pretty busy urban area.
I hope the squirrels stay safe.
I will put out a squirrel feeder.
I will try to plant more trees in my yard.
I once saw a squirrel climb up a tree trunk that was almost vertical.
I love how squirrels flick their bushy tails around.
I have asked whether someone has ever seen a squirrel do that.
